identification: Modern (late 20th century) solid Tasmanian blackwood chiffonier-style sideboard, H143 W153 D50 cm: arched shaped back with shelf on turned supports, two moulded frieze drawers, three arched-panel doors (well-figured blackwood panels, the right one dark-streaked), applied turned half-columns at the front corners, turned bun feet, two fixed internal shelves. Clean, glossy modern lacquer, sharp machined edges, machine-made drawers; good condition. Armitage estimate A$120-160.

viewing_check: Look for a maker label inside a drawer or on the back (Coogans, a Tasmanian craftsman), solid vs veneer on the door panels and top, and any sun-fade or water marks on the top. Only worth it as furniture for use, at around the A$120-160 estimate.
